messages:
Nina: dropping a quick thread for the embeddings/re-rank UI tweaks I sketched. main goals: make bulk preview + export reliable for large batches, reduce accidental exports, and improve score legibility (esp for colorblind). Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-embeddings/ui-export (frames: ExportFlow, PreviewList, RelevanceCompact).

Owen: looked good. first thought: left filter rail takes up too much real estate when previewing vectors. propose collapsible filters (icon + count) so table can be wider. also 'sticky id' column for row context when scrolling horizontally.

Priya: yes on sticky column. also re: export action text: prefer "Download results" vs "Export" to make it clearer to non-technical users. if rows are selected show "Download selection (n)".

Kai: accessibility: score color ramp currently uses red-yellow-green, which fails for some users. Suggest dual encoding: color + small numeric badge. Badge should have role="status" for screen readers. Also make the badge contrast 4.5:1 with text.

Nina: good call. UX tradeoff: color + text will increase clutter; propose 'compact' row density mode for power users where numeric badges are hidden by default but available via hover or an opt-in toggle.

Owen: pagination vs infinite scroll: with large batches I prefer server-queued export rather than client streaming. UI should show a queue card with progress bar and ETA. clicking the card opens job details with logs. for small downloads allow immediate browser download. we need a rule: if rows > 5k or bytes > 5MB -> server job.

Priya: copy for server job states: queued -> running -> ready -> failed. microcopy for ready state should be "Your download is ready (3.4 MB)" with a button "Download now" and small text "Expires in 7 days". On failure show actionable hint: "Retry" and "Contact support".

Kai: keyboard flow: table rows need a visible focus style, arrow keys move through rows, space toggles selection, Enter expands preview. The preview drawer should trap focus and have an accessible close button (aria-label="Close preview").

Nina: export format options: CSV, JSONL, and a compact CSV (no embedding_dim/model) for analysts. Also include a checkbox "include full text" because some orgs want snippets only for PII reasons. default: include snippet truncated to 250 chars.

Owen: CSV quoting rules: always quote text_snippet and escape newlines with "\\n". header names: use camelCase to match other APIs (vectorId, batchName, textSnippet, rawScore, normScore, model, dim). we should debate snake_case vs camelCase but keep consistent across platform.

Priya: I'd rather keep snake_case for CSVs since many downstream ETL tools expect that. who owns the canonical naming? @design-bot can we surface the current platform convention?

design-bot: platform convention: internal APIs use camelCase; exported artifacts historically used snake_case. Recommendation: keep snake_case for CSV/JSONL exports for backwards compatibility. Event: preference noted.

Kai: small visual: rerank score column should be right aligned and use monospaced for numbers to improve scanability. consider showing both raw and percentile (p95 style) next to each other for power users.

Nina: thought: add an inline mini histogram in the header showing score distribution for the current result set. helps users set filters quickly. should be subtle (1-row high sparkline).

Owen: export modal UX: first step selection summary (Selected X rows / All Y rows); second step format & options (include full text, include metadata, newline escape); third step confirmation with estimated size/time. show sample first row in a tiny preview box.

Priya: sample preview useful. also add "Download sample (10 rows)" to let users check format before running a large job. reduce support tickets.

Kai: accessibility note: announce when a sample is ready and when an export job is created via aria-live polite region. for long jobs, update progress every 10% and announce completion. screen reader test required.

Nina: technical ask: backend needs to return estimated_size and estimated_rows in export_start response. UI needs to display and record telemetry: export_type, rows_count, user_triggered_sample.

design-bot: analytics suggestion: track export_sample_clicked, export_started, export_completed, export_failed with properties { format, rows, estimated_size_bytes, batch_ids }.

Owen: I'll mock updated table with sticky column + compact density and attach screenshots in a follow-up. also will add the pagination rule for server vs client downloads to the PR description.

Priya: final copy change: change CTA in top-level toolbar from "Export" to a dropdown: "Download results ▾" with quick options "Download visible", "Download selection", "Download sample". avoids accidental full dataset exports.

Kai: test matrix: keyboard-only, high-contrast, color-blind modes, NVDA, VoiceOver, and mobile narrow viewport. mobile: collapse filters into a bottom sheet and keep export choices accessible.

Nina: thanks everyone. action items: Owen - updated mocks + pagination rule; Priya - finalize CTA copy & confirmation text; Kai - keyboard/ARIA spec + test checklist; design-bot - add analytics events. follow-up sync Thu 9:30am. :coffee:
